services.name: Fairview Golf Course
services.desc: was the third addition to the Distinct Golf Group in the fall of 1966. The course, which opened in the late 1950’s, has matured into a great test of golf for players of all ages and skill levels. Our public golf course sits at the base of the south Gretna mountains in the beautiful Lebanon Valley, 5 miles from the PA Turnpike - Exit 266 (Lebanon/Lancaster). Being just a short drive from Hershey, Harrisburg, Reading and others, our golf course has become a favorite among golfers in the area.
